opinions.text: Appeal from the Appellate Department of the Superior Court of. California, Los Angeles County. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 352 U. S. 914.) Argued April 3, 1957. This case is restored to the docket for reargument. The Attorney General of California is invited to file a brief and to participate in the oral argument, the appellee’s time to be equally divided.
